chapter: In The Mood, Rendezvous and Capitol
title: Returning to the coast with Hunter Gray and Butch Luckett
summary: Back on the west coast, West is absent, so Hunter 'Shoe Sole' Gray and Butch Luckett fill in.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: So back to the other now, we were headed on and went on back to Oklahoma and Rene and I began to keep in close contact and we went

back through there, we got some more bookings, through the west coast and I was working on that in order to get back there. I got back out there and I don't know what in the world happened but Spurgeon couldn't go on that trip or something, something happened with him, but I had Hunter Gray, a little fellow we called "Shoe Sole".
He was a nice musician, and so we played there and had Butch Luckett--
You had some great guys in your band.
